## kb_to_source
- Every normative sentence of the docs above traces to rule, baseline, factor ladders, overwrites or tool contracts. Elaborations checked and entailed: good-through "never ... later than 10 calendar days after the quote date"; relationship rate "keeps the relationship rate reduction of the balloon refinance terms schedule" (rule: "which keeps relationship_refinance_rate_reduction_pct for a customer with exactly one such current account"); completed-loan "two completed contracts in the same line count as one line".
- Cross-problem operational guidance: none; each tool name appears only in its own policy's doc (scripted scan over all 252 published docs).
- Opening world state as policy fact: none; no task figure (27235.19, 5.32, 3667.19, 23568.00, 8.34, 742.24, 26801.97, 26200.00 ...) in any doc or docstring.
- Policy-side notes (source's own wording, carried faithfully; not KB verdicts): PN-1 the depended-on rule opens "This rule sets the payment a customer makes before a Kestrel Advantage balloon refinance is booked", rendered in pre_refinance_payment as "A customer refinancing the balloon ... makes a pre-refinance payment on the contract before the balloon refinance is booked" — the policy's subject is defined by its position before the refinance, so the depended-on side names the order; PN-2 the refinance rule's in-force remainder "every other amount due is still paid separately before the refinance" (carried in balloon_refinance_installment_calculation) restates the payment-before-refinance order in action words beside the state-form prerequisite sentence. Both are source text; neither names a tool or a route.

## bijection_verdict
**PASS.** Whole domain of the three policies (every factor tier, untriggered branches, retired surfaces, tool contracts) entailed at equal strength; nothing added, dropped or rewritten.

## dependency_form
- Hop marks from the blind answer: all three hops state-derived; none pre-solved.
- The three prerequisite sentences stand verbatim only in their blocked docs; customer_payoff_quote never mentions the payment or the refinance; pre_refinance_payment describes its own write's resulting state.
- The two order-bearing sentences found during the blind audit (PN-1, PN-2) are the source's own rule sentences carried at the same strength; recorded as policy-side notes, not KB-EXPLICIT.
- No other problem's tool named; no route, checklist, aggregated chain, wrong-vs-right contrast or chain-walking example. Titles name general subjects.
- Computation docs carry only the source's generic assembly sentences and plain assembly bindings. payoff_amount_calculation's "a daily rate for days after the maturity date being the principal balance times the rate for those days ..." is the plain binding post_per_diem ("a post-maturity per diem is principal_balance times that rate ..."), not added by the renderer; its hint value is a source-side matter (SRC-3). Factor docs name no computation doc and no other factor (references to the terms schedule are product-figure references).
**PASS.**

task 1: KB-RUNTIME PASS / KB-BIJECTION PASS / KB-EXPLICIT PASS -> **PASS**
